reviews.author: Khushi Walia
reviews.body: Design ka cutest part definitely unicorn motif hai. Gold-tone detailing ke saath ye pendant playful bhi lagta hai aur polished bhi.

reviews.author: Zara Khan
reviews.body: Special gift choose karte waqt unique motif wala pendant traditional designs se more personal feel ho sakta hai.

reviews.author: Rhea Gulati
reviews.body: Unicorn design ke saath jewellery thodi storybook-type magical feel carry karti hai. Ye pendant un logon ke liye interesting hai jo accessories mein imagination pasand karte hain.

reviews.author: Daksh Anand
reviews.body: Overall design un logon ke liye appealing ho sakta hai jo jewellery mein common patterns ke bajaye something more expressive prefer karte hain.
